summary: Pit stop readiness evaluation for the pit machine: defaults the ready flag this+0x190 to 1, clears it if the squared wheel-spin magnitude from obj+0x34F8/0x34FC/0x3500 exceeds a small threshold, forces camera mode 1, and in pit-stop mode recomputes readiness from the tire-compound decision (or forces not-ready when dword_7CE048 is set); when ready, records the pit timer (this+0x1A0 and completion this+0x1A4), runs a 3D transform on the secondary object, and for the player vehicle arms the pit-mid flag this+0x1AC and triggers a short computation on the session manager with a side-dependent argument.

operations.description: Default the pit-ready flag this+0x190 to 1.
Square magnitude of wheel spin from obj+0x34F8, obj+0x34FC and obj+0x3500; if greater than 0.040000003 the vehicle is moving too fast for a pit stop.
Clear the pit-ready flag this+0x190 to 0 when the vehicle is moving too fast.
Force the camera mode to 1 via CameraModeSetter.
Pit stop mode active: the pit state flag obj+0x32C8 on the base vehicle equals 1.
Update the race-start countdown state via RaceStartCountdownStateUpdate(0).
Recompute the pit-ready flag from the tire-compound decision PitStopDecisionTireCompound(base vehicle).
Alternative readiness override: global dword_7CE048 equals 1 forces not-ready.
Clear the pit-ready flag this+0x190 to 0 when dword_7CE048 is set.
Ready check: pit-ready flag this+0x190 set gates pit timer arming and player-vehicle pit-mid handling.
Store the session-time argument into the pit timer target this+0x1A0.
Query the pit operation duration via PitStopOperationTimer(this).
Set the pit timer completion this+0x1A4 to the operation timer result plus the stored target this+0x1A0.
Secondary object present at this+0x8 gates the 3D transform dispatch.
Build a 3D transform via F_3DTransformWithMatrixMultiplication and dispatch sub_4A3320 on the secondary object with the result.
Player vehicle check: base vehicle equals the player pointer dword_7C54E8, pit-mid flag this+0x1AC clear, and global dword_7CE814 clear.
Arm the pit-mid flag this+0x1AC to 1 for the player's pit entry.
Run a short computation on the session manager dword_5EA510 via ShortComputation_d3c0, argument 9 normally or 10 when the side flag byte_5EA3EC is set.
